# The Agent Engineer — Balaji Chippada

> Production-grade Agentic AI course (16 modules, self-paced, no prerequisites) plus a free 26-week Agentic AI Engineer roadmap and live masterclasses. RAG, MCP, LangGraph, multi-agent systems, evaluation, guardrails, deployment — taught by an engineer who ships agents in production.

Balaji Chippada teaches software engineers to architect, evaluate and deploy reliable AI agents. The site has two learning tracks: a paid flagship course, **Agentic AI at Production Level**, and a **free 26-week roadmap** (open, no paywall) with embedded video lessons and progress tracking. Live masterclasses run alongside both.

## Flagship course — "Agentic AI at Production Level"

A production-first engineering course: design agent architectures, wire up tools and memory, orchestrate multiple agents, and stand up the evals, guardrails and monitoring you need in front of real users.

- **Format**: Self-paced video course — 16 modules, 265+ lessons
- **Level**: Starter → advanced. **Prerequisites: none** — Python is taught inside the course; no AI/ML background, CS degree, or work experience required
- **Price**: ₹29,999 launch offer for the first 45 days (regular ₹34,999). One-time payment, 18% GST included, no subscription
- **Access**: 2 years, including every update released in that window. Content refreshed biweekly
- **Practice**: Quiz after every video; multiple real-engineering assignments per module (concrete inputs, a clear deliverable, "done when" criteria)
- **Projects**: 9 hands-on builds published on the site; the course includes 3 capstone projects and 2 personal projects. One product is carried through the whole course and upgraded module by module
- **Support**: Doubts answered within 24 working hours, weekly live sessions and office hours, private community, code reviews
- **Career**: 2 one-to-one mock interviews with actionable feedback, plus resume preparation
- **Certificate**: Awarded only after completing the full course, having every assignment reviewed and approved, and completing all mock interviews — not a participation certificate
- **Who it's for**: Complete beginners starting from scratch, and working software engineers targeting roles like Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who can code but have never taken an agent to production

### Course curriculum (16 modules)

1. Python Fundamentals — 32 lessons (Colab setup, data structures, control flow, functions, file I/O, NumPy, Pandas)
2. Advanced Python — 22 lessons
3. NLP Basics, Intuition-First — 17 lessons
4. LLM Internals and LangChain — 17 lessons
5. Prompt Engineering — 24 lessons
6. Foundations of Agentic Systems — 18 lessons
7. RAG — Retrieval-Augmented Generation — 24 lessons
8. MCP — Model Context Protocol — 17 lessons
9. Memory & Optimization — 13 lessons
10. State Machines & DAGs (LangGraph) — 13 lessons
11. Evaluation — 10 lessons
12. Multi-Agent Orchestration — 11 lessons
13. Security & Guardrails — 12 lessons
14. Deployment (incl. FastAPI) — 12 lessons
15. Monitoring & Operations — 11 lessons
16. Capstone Projects & Portfolio — 12 lessons

### Sample projects

- Mini LangChain From Scratch — model loading, chat-model abstractions, provider integrations, APIs
- Semantic Search Over Your Documents — embeddings, chunking, cosine similarity, top-K retrieval
- Multi-Model Chatbot With Full Control — LangChain + Streamlit, provider switching, temperature/reasoning/streaming
- Advanced Prompting Upgrade — prompt templates, versioning, LCEL chains, conversation history, prompt caching
- Agentic Power Upgrade — Plan-Act-Observe-Reflect loop, tools, web search, self-correction, retry limits
- Advanced RAG System — indexing pipeline, hybrid search, reranking, metadata filtering, low latency, evaluations, RBAC

## Free 26-week roadmap (no paywall)

Open, free, and staying free — 9 phases, 60+ modules, 3 capstone projects, with embedded YouTube lessons and account-synced progress tracking.

1. Python Foundations (weeks 1–3) — Core Python, OOP, HTTP APIs, FastAPI, async
2. LLM Mental Model (week 4) — Tokenization, context windows, reasoning models, benchmarks
3. Prompt Engineering (weeks 5–7) — API access, CoT, prompt caching, DSPy
4. RAG + Evaluation (weeks 8–12) — Embeddings, chunking, vector DBs, Ragas eval
5. Tools, MCP & Single Agents (weeks 13–16) — Function calling, ReAct, LangChain agents
6. Memory & Context (weeks 17–19) — Episodic memory, semantic cache, compression
7. Multi-Agent Orchestration (weeks 20–22) — LangGraph, supervisor patterns, A2A
8. Guardrails & LLMOps (weeks 23–24) — Input/output/action guardrails, observability
9. Cloud Deployment (weeks 25–26) — AWS ECS, API Gateway, cost control

Roadmap capstones: distributed document ingestion + RAG pipeline (phase 4), multi-agent orchestration system (phase 7), production agent on AWS (phase 9).

**Course vs. free roadmap**: the YouTube channel and the roadmap explain the concepts and will always be free. The course adds one enforced sequence, quizzes, reviewed assignments, capstones, a product you keep upgrading, 24-hour doubt support, weekly live sessions, mock interviews, resume prep, and biweekly updates.
